# Deployment and integration issues

| Problem | Answer! |
| --- | --- |
| ** Does Kuailu Technology provide system-based deployment services?** | Deployment and implementation services may be provided on the basis of client range, system environment and security requirements; deliverables, cycles, training, costs and liability boundaries are based on confirmed project programmes and contracts. |
| ** Support privatization? | Privatization deployments can be supported under product programmes; source code delivery, open interfaces, authorized boundaries with secondary development are based on quotations and contracts. |
| ** Does the finance module support silver docking?** | Bank interfaces depend on bank interfaces, product versions, safety requirements and project configurations, and need to be followed by needs assessments to confirm the scope of access and implementation cycles. |
| ** Support integration with existing office entrances? ** | The scope of integration depends on the open interface of existing office platforms, the delegation of authority, product versions purchased and project configuration; it should be based on an empirical list of interfaces and implementation options. |
| ** Does the write-off system support hardware equipment docking?** | Hardware alignment depends on the equipment model, communication protocol, driver, interface privileges and product version; the list of validated equipment and scope of implementation should be confirmed in the project evaluation. |
| ** Does the system support ERP and treasury interfaces?** | The range of access depends on the target system interface, fields, privileges, data quality and product version; reading and writing ranges, synchronized frequency and implementation modalities should be specified in the interface list and project programme. |
| ** How long does the system have to be privatized and deployed free of charge?** | Free coverage of the privatization project, renewal criteria, time of service and level of response are based on quotations, contracts or service-level agreements. |
| ** Is the existing software available?** | Existing systems can be connected through API, validated connectors or project-level data interfaces. Access systems, read-and-written ranges, data migration and go-live patterns need to be validated on the basis of interfaces, authorizations, data quality and project scope. |
| ** How can the differences between Kuailu Cloud and the common office collaboration platform be assessed? ** | At the same time, at the same time, in the same version, in the manner of deployment and on the scale of use, comparison should be made between immediate communications, operational management, visualization, AI capability, system integration, security of authority, service delivery and overall cost; no characterization of the lack of evidence of the same conditions. |
| ** Does Kuailu AI CRM support docking with existing financial systems?** | The range of access depends on the target system interface, fields, privileges, data quality and product version; reading and writing ranges, synchronized frequency and implementation modalities should be specified in the interface list and project programme. |
| **Can historical data from existing systems be migrated?** | Historical data in the confirmed range can be migrated, for example, through interfaces or file import; migration objects, field mapping, data cleansing, validation and rollback programmes need to be determined according to the source system and project range. |
| **Was it possible to access Kuailu AI CRM? ** | Advertising trail access depends on the target platform ' s open interface, account authorization, field rules and Kuailu AI CRM versions, which should be based on the validated platform list and project programme. |
| ** Is the application built with Kuailu platform capable of independent deployment and secondary development?** | Independent deployment, code or configuration export and secondary development borders depend on the purchase of the version, the delegation of authority agreement and the project programme, and the range of capabilities for different deployment modalities may vary. |

## Platform-level integration capacity

| Integration Method | Confirmed caliber |
| --- | --- |
| Software and data | Support for API integration, database interface, synchronisation of job profiles, advertising trail access and historical data migration |
| Hardware | Supporting hardware interfaces with scanners, PDAs, etc. |
| Project boundary | The actual scope depends on each other ' s systems interface, equipment agreement, authorization, data quality and project programme |
